Controls undergoing fresh autologous IVF cycles
Women with a freeze-all embryos cycle (FAE) for endometrial fluid (EF)
Previous pelvic or endometrial surgery (polypectomy or synechia removal)
outcome: Presence of endometrial fluid (EF) during IVF
cohort: 86 women with EF undergoing FAE cycles and 171 controls undergoing fresh autologous IVF cycles at a university-affiliated private IVF center between 2010 and 2016
finding: Independent risk factors for EF were a history of previous myomectomy, severe endometriosis, PCOS, and previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was independently associated with an increased risk of EF (aOR 5.17, 95%CI [1.84-14.49]).
